concept: Macie: discovering PII and sensitive data in S3
tests: Choosing a service for automated, continuous discovery of PII/card numbers in S3 with alerts.
expected: Amazon Macie — ML classification of S3 content (PII, financial data), findings → EventBridge/Security Hub. Triggers: "discover sensitive data", "PII", "credit card numbers", "across many S3 buckets".
why_not: Config — configuration compliance; GuardDuty — threats from logs; CloudTrail — API log; none of them analyzes object contents.
